notes: The piezo is modelled with the catalogue 'buzzer' type (ports 1, 2). Port 1 is taken as the ground (black lead) side and port 2 as the signal (red lead) side.

In the image the breadboard's rows f-j are drawn at the top. These are mapped to bank 'b' following the catalogue naming (bank 'b' = rows f-j). Columns are read from the image: piezo legs in columns 5 and 8, row i; resistor in row h across columns 5 and 8.
The black wire goes from the Uno GND pin next to pin 13 (GND.1) to hole 5g, the ground side of the piezo. The red wire goes from A0 to hole 8f, the signal side.
The resistor is 1 Megohm and sits in parallel with the piezo. The value is stored as 1000000 ohms.
Hardware list items 'solid surface' and the USB cable are not part of the circuit and are omitted.
